split_race.validation: membership epoch1 A,B plus exact A,B confirmations
split_race.candidate_commit: separate coordination g1->g2 using unchanged coordination SHA

canonical_race.validation: canonical epoch1 A,B/g1 plus exact A,B confirmations; retain canonical SHA S
canonical_race.intervention: same canonical record -> epoch2 A,B,C/g1 using S
canonical_race.candidate_commit: stale pre-validation epoch1 A,B/g2 payload using old S exactly once

canonical_stable.validation: canonical epoch1 A,B/g1 plus exact A,B confirmations
canonical_stable.candidate_commit: canonical epoch1 A,B/g1->g2 using validation SHA
